public.text: “Client” is preferred because it includes patients, carers, service users, and community members. A carer may also require a distinct identity and relationship role rather than being represented as the subject of a health-service record.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that the registry identifies persons and represents their relevant roles and relationships separately. Consider whether Person Registry for Health is a clearer, less service-oriented term.
